about: Worker C's monitor test (Nov 16, Corey approved; runs LAST, after every launch another worker waits on). Does detaching the monitors explain the morning's fast frames? One con_custodial launch, gate settings, holding y0_p0 after the bench window, no input during steps: live steps monitorStep both_on, second_off (DDC/CI VCP 0xD6=5 on ACI27A8 through a handle opened while attached, the method monitor_proof.py proves; put back on with 0xD6=1 after its hold), both_off (Corey switches both monitors off together by remote; the step runs from the first poll reading both detached to the last one; recorded as skipped if they do not both detach within 600 s), both_on_again (starts once both read attached and the display state reads on). Each live_stepN window records monitors, monitorsRaw and gameWindow at start and end and the wall clock; monitor_layout.json holds the layout before and after. Score: python -I tests\analysis\monitor_steps.py <spot folder>. Exit 0 = scored (Q1 may read NOT ANSWERED), 1 = VOID.
